description: Arrange up to 9 photos into a collage layout (duo, trio, focus, quad, six, nine) with a gap and background color, and get back a square PNG.

images.description: Photos as base64, data URIs, or public URLs. Private addresses are refused. 10 MB cap each.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

layout.description: Layout id: duo, duo-stack, trio, focus, quad, six, nine. Unknown ids fall back to quad.

width.description: Output width in pixels; the collage is square.

name: make_collage

cells.description: Cells in the layout; cells beyond the image count stay background-colored.

title: Make a photo collage
